95:                     img_data = requests.get(preview_url, timeout=5).content
96:                     image = QImage()
97:                     if image.loadFromData(img_data) and not image.isNull():
98:                         pixmap = QPixmap.fromImage(image)
99:                         if not pixmap.isNull():
100:                             icon = QIcon(pixmap.scaled(QSize(300, 200), Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio))
101:                 except Exception as e:
102:                     print(f"[!] Image preview failed: {url} - {e}")
103:             elif self.download_previews and url.endswith(('.mp4', '.webm')):
104:                 thumb = extract_video_preview(url)
105:                 if thumb:
106:                     image = QImage(thumb)
107:                     if not image.isNull():
108:                         pixmap = QPixmap.fromImage(image)
109:                         if not pixmap.isNull():
110:                             icon = QIcon(pixmap.scaled(QSize(300, 200), Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio))
111:             self.signals.result.emit(url, icon)
112:         self.signals.finished.emit()
113: 
114: class ForensicSearchGUI(QWidget):
115:     def __init__(self):
116:         super().__init__()
117:         self.setWindowTitle("Forensic Search Toolkit")
118:         self.setGeometry(100, 100, 1200, 800)
119:         self.thread_pool = QThreadPool()
120: 
121:         layout = QVBoxLayout()
122:         self.search_input = QLineEdit()
123:         self.search_input.setPlaceholderText("Enter forensic search term")
124:         self.search_button = QPushButton("Search")
125:         self.export_button = QPushButton("Export Selected URLs")
126:         self.open_button = QPushButton("Open Selected in Browser")
127:         self.download_checkbox = QCheckBox("Auto-download previews")
128:         self.mode_selector = QComboBox()
129:         self.mode_selector.addItems(["all", "images", "videos"])
130: 
131:         self.result_list = QListWidget()
132:         self.preview_box = QTextBrowser()
133: 
134:         layout.addWidget(QLabel("🔍 Forensic Search Engine"))
135:         layout.addWidget(self.search_input)
136:         layout.addWidget(self.mode_selector)
137:         layout.addWidget(self.search_button)
138:         layout.addWidget(self.download_checkbox)
139:         layout.addWidget(self.result_list, stretch=3)
140:         layout.addWidget(self.export_button)
141:         layout.addWidget(self.open_button)
142:         layout.addWidget(QLabel("Selected URL Preview:"))
143:         layout.addWidget(self.preview_box)
144: 
145:         self.setLayout(layout)
146:         self.search_button.clicked.connect(self.execute_search)
147:         self.export_button.clicked.connect(self.export_selected)
148:         self.open_button.clicked.connect(self.open_selected_in_browser)
149:         self.result_list.itemClicked.connect(self.display_preview)
150: 
151:         self.result_links = {}
152: 
153:     def execute_search(self):
154:         self.result_list.clear()
155:         self.result_links.clear()
156:         query = self.search_input.text().strip()
157:         if not query:
158:             return
159: 
160:         self.search_button.setText("Searching...")
161:         self.search_button.setEnabled(False)
162: 
163:         mode = self.mode_selector.currentText()
164:         worker = SearchWorker(query, self.download_checkbox.isChecked(), mode)
165:         worker.signals.result.connect(self.add_result_item)
166:         worker.signals.finished.connect(self.search_done)
167:         self.thread_pool.start(worker)
168: 
169:     def add_result_item(self, url, icon):
170:         item = QListWidgetItem(url)
171:         item.setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Unchecked)
172:         if not icon.isNull():
173:             item.setIcon(icon)
174:         self.result_list.addItem(item)
175:         self.result_links[url] = "(preview)"
176: 
177:     def search_done(self):
178:         self.search_button.setText("Search")
179:         self.search_button.setEnabled(True)
180: 
181:     def display_preview(self, item):
182:         url = item.text()
183:         self.preview_box.setText(f"URL: {url}\n\nPreview: {self.result_links.get(url, 'N/A')}")
184: 
185:     def export_selected(self):
186:         options = QFileDialog.Options()
187:         filename, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(self, "Save Selected URLs", "selected_urls.txt", "Text Files (*.txt)", options=options)
188:         if not filename:
189:             return
190:         with open(filename, 'w') as f:
191:             for i in range(self.result_list.count()):
192:                 item = self.result_list.item(i)
193:                 if item.checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked:
194:                     f.write(item.text() + "\n")
195: 
196:     def open_selected_in_browser(self):
197:         for i in range(self.result_list.count()):
198:             item = self.result_list.item(i)
199:             if item.checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked:
200:                 webbrowser.open(item.text())
201: 
202: if __name__ == '__main__':
203:     app = QApplication(sys.argv)
204:     gui = ForensicSearchGUI()
205:     gui.show()
206:     sys.exit(app.exec())

content.text: I'll create a single combined file with a 3x3 grid layout for previews instead of the scrolling list. I'll use `QGridLayout` within a scroll area for the 9-panel display.

Created [forensic_toolkit.py](file:///c:/Users/ek930/OneDrive/Desktop/X12/VFP-Video-forensic-platform/forensic_toolkit.py) - a single combined file with:

- **All scrapers** integrated inline (no separate imports needed)
- **9-panel grid layout** (3x3) for previews instead of scrolling list  
- **Pagination** with Previous/Next buttons to navigate through results
- **Dark themed UI** with clickable preview cards
- **Double-click** any card to open in browser
- **Select All on Page** button for batch selection

Run with: `python forensic_toolkit.py`
